units.source_text: 但是，不管是什么样的有钱人，金钱总是有数的，

en.t: But no matter what kind of rich person someone may be, money is always limited,

units.source_text: 这样过了一两年，挥霍成性的杜子春逐渐露出的贫穷的迹象。

en.t: After a year or two passed like this, signs of poverty gradually began to show in the spendthrift Du Zichun.

units.source_text: 人都是薄情寡义的，昨天还在登门拜访的朋友，

en.t: People are all cold and ungrateful; even the friends who came calling yesterday

units.source_text: 今天就算路过你家门口也不会搭理你半句话。

en.t: would not say even half a word to you today, even if they passed by your door.

units.source_text: 终于，到了第三年春天的时候，

en.t: At last, when the spring of the third year arrived,

units.source_text: 杜子春又回到了之前的境遇，倾家荡产，身无分文。

en.t: Du Zichun had returned to his former condition, ruined, with his household gone and not a coin to his name.

units.source_text: 如此大的洛阳大都会，有没有属于他的一间屋子了，不是的，

en.t: In the vast metropolis of Luoyang, did he have even one room that belonged to him? No, he did not,

units.source_text: 不仅仅是没有容身之处了，

en.t: and it was not only that he had no place to stay,

units.source_text: 现在，连愿意给他一碗凉水的人都没有了。

en.t: now there was not even anyone willing to give him a bowl of cold water.
